text.tspan: NAWIRI PAMOJA
Growing Together. Thriving Together
Nawiri Pamoja
Growing Together. Thriving Together
The Nawiri Pamoja logo symbolises people coming together to grow and thrive. At its heart,
the human figure represents the individual and the community, while the embracing form
conveys protection, care and belonging. The upward-reaching blue elements represent unity
and progress, evolving into leaf-like forms that symbolise growth, renewal and prosperity.
The combination of blue and orange communicates trust, strength, optimism and
opportunity—bringing the promise of “Growing Together. Thriving Together” to life.
NAWIRI
PAMOJA
Growing Together. Thriving Together
The open book represents education and knowledge, the green arcs and dots
symbolise community and collective growth, the flame represents inspiration
and potential, while the star signifies hope, aspiration and achievement.
The Nawiri Pamoja logo uses Education (the open book base)
as the launchpad for a brighttomorrow. Out of the book rises a Sunrise of hope,
containing a Community of unified people who are guided by a
central Star of excellence and shared vision.
NAWIRI
PAMOJA
Growing Together. Thriving Together
The Nawiri Pamoja logo uses an interconnected emblem where Education (the open book)
feeds into Growth (the plant sprout) to ultimately uplift the Community (the human figure).
It functions as a complete ecosystem showing that when people
learn and grow together, they flourish together.
DONGRUOK
KANYAKLA
Growing Together. Thriving Together
